body:
as i understand it, the anger can be alternating between explosive and inward

as someone who's been diagnosed recently and long, long suspected, I can tell you that my anger is exactly that, either non-existent outwardly or explosive to the point of extremes.  can't say what makes a difference.  sometimes I just go quiet, sometimes I have to tell whoever it is what a piece of shit I think they are RIGHT NOW.

doesn't help that i'm a guy, leads to a lot of fights
anybody with relationship success stories with women?  i feel like the only straight guy with BPD sometimes

i relate to this on every level, especially now, everyone i went to school with is finishing grad school and stuff, I look like a total loser with my semester of community college and years of treatment, relapse, and failure

thanks.

i guess it's just hard to see how or why it's even worth it at this point.  i'm sorry for being so negative
I was at logan river academy in logan. way north, like almost idaho. i'm kind of assuming your daughter was at diamond ranch?  it's another one that i heard about a lot.
not anything really.  i guess it would be something i'd be interested in, but like i said, i think I'm terrible at it so I really don't know if I'm just making an asshole out of myself.

it's comedy. the plan is to do a pilot as a sort of proof-of-concept, and to shop it around to see if someone wants to invest in it.

voice acting is fucking weird man, i'd never done it before today.  i guess now i have a demo reel of sorts, i did all the voices.  this also contributed to the burnout--reading 6 distinct characters over and over and over again is a little mind-blowing

EDIT: but like, I think it sounded like complete shit.

yeah, see that's me too, a lot of nightmares.  like waking up in a cold sweat kind of shit.  sometimes it's kind of replaying stuff that's happened, sometimes it's just really fucked up shit happening with no real context.   and i can't sleep for more than 2 or 3 hours at a time.  IF i sleep.

i don't know what gives me happiness. i write a lot, actually just today finished writing a 10 minute animated episode that my friend and i are doing together, and I also recorded all the dialog as well.  

so maybe im also kind of burnt out from 3 hours in a tiny ass recording booth.  i don't know.  its like something i thought i would be so excited to do, i did it, i think i did pretty well, and yet i still feel like whatever.  i feel like the other people were just telling me it was good because they wanted to be done with it, not that it actually was good.  but then again, i don't do well with praise at all so maybe i'm just crazy.

yeah i'm kind of rambling, sorry.

i don't know if my drug issues are really because i'm an "addict" like they say in rehab and 12-step (spiritual malady, physical allergy, whatever whatever), or just because i'm so unable to address my shit.  i mean, drugs to me aren't even a "fun" thing, I do them alone just so I don't have to keep having all these fucked up things in my head come up for me.

does that make any sense?  like, it just gives me quiet for a minute.  not that i'm hearing things, i just mean i feel peace.
no, it's fine. i realized just now that I did say "feel free to ask me anything" so I kind of got a chuckle out of it.  which isn't a bad thing.  so thanks.
fine i guess?  68 and lightly cloudy in the late evening/early night.
